lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਓਇ ਭਵਨਾ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਬਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n s thaan dha(n)n oi bhavanaa jaa mahi sa(n)t basaare ||
lines.translation: Blessed is that place, and blessed is that house, in which the Saints dwell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kee saradhaa poorahu thaakur bhagat tere namasakaare ||2||9||40||
lines.translation: Fulfill this desire of servant Nanak, O Lord Master, that he may bow in reverence to Your devotees. ||2||9||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਡਾਇ ਲੀਓ ਮਹਾ ਬਲੀ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhadaai leeo mahaa balee te apane charan paraat ||
lines.translation: He has saved me from the awful power of Maya, by attaching me to His feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਮਨ ਮੰਤਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek naam deeo man ma(n)taa binas na katahoo jaat ||1||
lines.translation: He gave my mind the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, which shall never perish or leave me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur poorai keenee daat ||
lines.translation: The Perfect True Guru has given this gift.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਾਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam deeo keeratan kau bhaee hamaaree gaat || rahaau ||
lines.translation: He has blessed me with the Kirtan of the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and I am emancipated. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apunai bhagatan kee raakhee paat ||
lines.translation: My God has made me His own, and saved the honor of His devotee.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak charan gahe prabh apane sukh paaio din raat ||2||10||41||
lines.translation: Nanak has grasped the feet of his God, and has found peace, day and night. ||2||10||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਹਰਨਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠ ਨਿੰਦ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਦਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: par haranaa lobh jhooth ni(n)d iv hee karat gudaaree ||
lines.translation: Stealing the property of others, acting in greed, lying and slandering - in these ways, he passes his life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਆਸ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੀਠੀ ਇਹ ਟੇਕ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਾਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mrig trisanaa aas mithiaa meethee ih tek manahi saadhaaree ||1||
lines.translation: He places his hopes in false mirages, believing them to be sweet; this is the support he installs in his mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਆਵਰਦਾ ਜਾਇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat kee aavaradaa jaai brithaaree ||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic passes his life uselessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਗਦ ਕੇ ਭਾਰ ਮੂਸਾ ਟੂਕਿ ਗਵਾਵਤ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise kaagad ke bhaar moosaa took gavaavat kaam nahee gaavaaree || rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is like the mouse, gnawing away at the pile of paper, making it useless to the poor wretch. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟਕਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa paarabraham suaamee ih ba(n)dhan chhutakaaree ||
lines.translation: Have mercy on me, O Supreme Lord God, and release me from these bonds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਅੰਧ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਢਤ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: boodat a(n)dh naanak prabh kaadhat saadh janaa sa(n)gaaree ||2||11||42||
lines.translation: The blind are sinking, O Nanak; God saves them, uniting them with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||11||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੀਤਲ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਛਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apanaa seetal tan man chhaatee ||
lines.translation: Remembering, remembering God, the Lord Master in meditation, my body, mind and heart are cooled and soothed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੂਖ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੋਰੈ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: roop ra(n)g sookh dhan jee kaa paarabraham morai jaatee ||1||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God is my beauty, pleasure, peace, wealth, soul and social status. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨਿ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa raam rasaain maatee ||
lines.translation: My tongue is intoxicated with the Lord, the source of nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀ ਰਾਮ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਥਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g ra(n)gee raam apane kai charan kamal nidh thaatee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am in love, in love with the Lord's lotus feet, the treasure of riches. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa tin hee rakh leeaa pooran prabh kee bhaatee ||
lines.translation: I am His - He has saved me; this is God's perfect way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: mel leeo aape sukhadaatai naanak har raakhee paatee ||2||12||43||
lines.translation: The Giver of peace has blended Nanak with Himself; the Lord has preserved his honor. ||2||12||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਵਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: doot dusaman sabh tujh te nivarahi pragat prataap tumaaraa ||
lines.translation: All demons and enemies are eradicated by You, Lord; Your glory is manifest and radiant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਦੁਖਾਏ ਓਹੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo tere bhagat dukhaae ohu tatakaal tum maaraa ||1||
lines.translation: Whoever harms Your devotees, You destroy in an instant. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirakhau tumaree or har neet ||
lines.translation: I look to You continually, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: muraar sahaai hohu daas kau kar gahi udharahu meet || rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Destroyer of ego, please, be the helper and companion of Your slaves; take my hand, and save me, O my Friend! ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sunee benatee thaakur merai khasamaanaa kar aap ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and given me His protection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਭਏ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak anad bhae dukh bhaage sadaa sadaa har jaap ||2||13||44||
lines.translation: Nanak is in ecstasy, and his pains are gone; he meditates on the Lord, forever and ever. ||2||13||44||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਲੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੁ ਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: chatur disaa keeno bal apanaa sir oopar kar dhaario ||
lines.translation: He has extended His power in all four directions, and placed His hand upon my head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਟਾਖੵ ਅਵਲੋਕਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa kataakhy avalokan keeno daas kaa dookh bidaario ||1||
lines.translation: Gazing upon me with his Eye of Mercy, He has dispelled the pains of His slave. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan raakhe gur govi(n)d ||
lines.translation: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has saved the Lord's humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਮੇਟੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਖਸੰਦ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)th laai avagun sabh mete daiaal purakh bakhasa(n)d || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Hugging me close in His embrace, the merciful, forgiving Lord has erased all my sins. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo maagahi thaakur apune te soee soee devai ||
lines.translation: Whatever I ask for from my Lord and Master, he gives that to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas mukh te jo bolai eehaa oohaa sach hovai ||2||14||45||
lines.translation: Whatever the Lord's slave Nanak utters with his mouth, proves to be true, here and hereafter. ||2||14||45||
